title: Radio Disturbance and Immunity Measuring Apparatus and Methods, Part 1: Radio Disturbance and Immunity Measuring Apparatus
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 10052 (PART 1)) covers Radio Disturbance and Immunity Measuring Apparatus and Methods, Part 1: Radio Disturbance and Immunity Measuring Apparatus. This Indian Standard (Part 1) (First Revision) which is identical with CISPR 1 6-1 (1 993) 'Specification for radio disturbance and immunity measuring apparatus and methods — Part 1 : Radio disturbance and immunity measuring apparatus' [ along with Amendment 1 (1 997)] issued by Special Committee on Radio Interference (CtSPR), was adopted by the Compatibility Sectional Committee and approval of the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. This standard (Part 1 ) was originally published in 1 982 and was largely based on CISPR 1 6(1 977) , Sectbn 1 . This revision is now being published to incorporate the latest developments in the technology in this field and also to align this standard with the latest edition of CISPR 16-1 . In the adopted standard, certain conventions are not identical to those used in Indian Standards.
